title: SigningRequestDetail
description: Detailed signing request as returned by GET /signing-requests/{id} (nested shape with status object and timestamps)

id.description: Unique identifier for the signing request

companies_workspaces_id.description: Workspace ID this signing request belongs to

document_url.description: Pre-signed URL to the PDF document

document_page_count.description: Number of pages in the document

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the signing request expires. Computed from sent_on + expiration_hours. Null if not sent yet or no expiration_hours set.

status.description: Status flags (multiple can be true for terminal states)

timestamps.description: All relevant timestamps for the signing request lifecycle

generated.description: Whether the final certificate PDF has been generated

has_error.description: Whether there was an error generating the certificate

final_document_download_url.description: Signed URL to download the final signed document (PDF with certificate). URL expires after 1 hour.

document_only_download_url.description: Signed URL to download the document-only PDF. URL expires after 1 hour.

certificate_only_download_url.description: Signed URL to download the certificate-only PDF. URL expires after 1 hour.

seal_participants.description: Organization seal participants in the signing order. Empty when the request has no seals.

SealParticipant.description: Seal participant on a signing request or template.

SigningRequestSettings.description: Settings returned by the signing request list and detail endpoints. Templates use the TemplateSettings schema (no identity fields).

allow_download.description: Whether recipients can download the document

attach_pdf_on_finish.description: Whether to attach PDF when signing is complete

allow_editing_before_sending.description: Whether the signing request can be edited before sending

use_signing_order.description: Whether signing order is enforced among recipients. When true, signers receive the document in sequence based on their order. When false, all signers receive the document simultaneously.

hand_drawn_only.description: When enabled, signers can only hand-draw their signatures and cannot use typed/font-based signatures

send_signing_email.description: Whether to send signing request notification emails to signers

send_finish_email.description: Whether to send completion email when all signers finish

send_expiration_email.description: Whether to send expiration notification email when request expires

send_cancellation_email.description: Whether to send cancellation notification email when request is cancelled

require_otp_verification.description: Whether signers must verify their email with a one-time code before accessing the document. null = inherit from workspace/company setting.

disable_guided_navigation.description: Disable automatic scrolling to the next required field during signing. Inherits from workspace or company if not set.

allow_presigning_download.description: Allow signers to download the original document before signing. Inherits from workspace or company setting when null.

show_qr_code.description: Show a QR code on the signing page that lets signers continue on their phone. Inherits from workspace or company setting when null.

identity_editable_fields.description: Identity fields signers may edit before signing (e.g. ["name", "company"]). null = disabled. When set, a confirmation dialog lets signers edit the specified fields.

notify_identity_change_email.description: Send an email notification when a signer changes their identity.
